name: Jeremy Vanderhal
office: Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Jeremy Vanderhal is an educator and engineer. He is an Air National Guard member. He was an Air Force test pilot and worked with the Federal Aviation Administration on aircraft certification. His priorities include high academic standards in reading, writing, and math. He calls for safe, respectful campuses with zero tolerance for hate and bullying, and parental transparency. He pledges not to accept contributions from parties, partisan PACs, or unions. He supports advocating for more state school funding to address class sizes and program quality. In 2023, he told the board that using a superintendent search firm affiliated with the district's law firm was a conflict of interest; a review found no conflict.
